value.title: Warning-first delivery and end-to-end proof
value.summary: Complete shared on-track and delivery-warning semantics across all ownership checks; prove the actual CLI/Git consumer workflow, integrity contrasts, documentation/skill cutover and archive re-observation.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Final advisory ownership cutover, shared on-track comparison and a fresh local-only native operational E2E scenario. Earlier blind/manual runs remain historical and are not relabelled as successful composition or guided orchestration.

value.title: Complete shared delivery and on-track warnings without weakening real integrity
Exercise the revised pipeline with actual isolated native participants

tk-0001.assertion: Guide ownership policies warn and remain visible through readiness, baseline, dispatch, import and advancement.
Committed coder history, including reverted out-of-map writes, produces the same file/owner rows in on-track and delivery.
On-track selects and names its actual basis, committed/working/untracked scope and incomplete observations, with exit zero and no mutation.
Live help, source skills, templates, packets and examples consistently describe guidance rather than ownership permission.

tk-0002.assertion: A fresh local-only native run performs actual packet dispatch, self-check/on-track observations, out-of-map deliveries and PM composition with warning evidence.
Actual wrong/mismatched delivery inputs refuse before mutation; valid pinned deliveries and later evidence remain usable.
An independent native reviewer assesses actual composed bytes, and canonical advancement/archival re-observation records the real outcomes without rewriting older runs.
Local transcripts, command receipts and Git/source artifacts are preserved with explicit proof limits and no Flowspace ingestion.
